scopeJustifications.goods:purchase:self: Sells the two items declared in `goods` (a style pack and a supporter badge) for Buzz. Each purchase shows its price and needs an explicit confirm in the block before any Buzz moves.
scopeJustifications.social:tip:self: Lets the viewer tip the person the model owner named as this install's tip recipient, behind an in-block confirm, and shows their remaining daily tip allowance.

goods.title: Style pack
goods.description: Unlocks six extra prompt styles in this block.

goods.title: Supporter badge
goods.description: A badge in this block that says you backed it.

tip_recipient_user_id.label: Tip recipient (Civitai user id)
tip_recipient_user_id.description: Who receives tips sent from this block on your model. Leave empty to hide tipping.
